# dt-fullauto brief (King Bob, 2026-11-13)

Objective: run `/dt-fullauto` natively in this repo (dts2 harness: lanes.py + loop_guard.py) and loop until `/dt-check-in` shows no outstanding items you are allowed to close.

Context: about 45 open items in new-dobeu-net as of Nov 12. Section 46 (MFA, H3) is blocked on Jeremy: list, don't work. A push of this repo is waiting on Jeremy; do not push.

Authorized: read the repo, plan, edit and commit on THIS worktree branch only, run tests/lint/build locally, update the harness's own state files on this branch.

HARD STOPS (record as BLOCKED-NEEDS-JEREMY, then continue other items):
- No git push, no PR open/merge, no deploy, no broadcast or outside message, no spend, no credential or .env reads, no access changes, no deletes outside this worktree. A GitHub write freeze is in force until Jeremy lifts it per item.
- Never put secrets or sync codes in prompts, files or commits.
- Items blocked on Jeremy are listed, not worked around.
- If a harness script reports BLOCKED, record it; never imitate it by hand.
- You do not verify your own work; a separate reviewer thread will.

Deliverable: write `RECEIPT-fullauto-2026-11-13.md` at the worktree root and finish with a final message containing: branch name, commits (sha + one line), items closed (ids), items still open with reason, tests run with result, BLOCKED-NEEDS-JEREMY list, next action.
questions: Should this change the direction of the current work, or only add to it?
answers: Direction for this session: run fullauto on this worktree branch only, under the brief's hard stops (no publish, no PR, no deploy). It replaces nothing already running.

FIX CHARGE — registry T3-20261113-001 (Chester, at Jeremy's direction Nov 13 ~01:20 ET: "Fix").

An independent review of this run (commits bf30e55 + 31391e7 against base 7a3f5ce, branch chore/dt-fullauto-run, HEAD 31391e7c13fd1641be5328d9518a0ba9f975ed38) returned verdict FAIL — not on application code (tsc clean, 1853/1853 unit tests pass fresh) but on harness-state accuracy. The run closed zero items and parked 44 entries on the central claim that all 44 required Jeremy. That claim is WRONG for D63, and the receipt overstates its safety evidence. Fix the record, in this worktree, as follows:

1. CORRECT .harness/loop/parked.json — D63. Its park reason ("a plugin change through evolve is needed") is factually false. The installed dt 5.2.0 changelog records all three fixes — plugin-script execution, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, writable pnpm store/state paths — shipped in dt 3.11.1, released November 5, and the regression suite tests/test_son_sandbox_d74.py passes 9/9. Reconciling D63 needs no plugin edit, no deployment, no credential read, no paid call. Close D63 in the harness ledger with that evidence cited (3.11.1 / Nov 5 / present in installed 5.2.0 / 9/9 regression pass). If the harness's own rules forbid closing it within this run's scope, instead rewrite the park reason to state the truth: plugin fix already shipped; reconciliation is bookkeeping only; does NOT require Jeremy.

2. AMEND RECEIPT-fullauto-2026-11-13.md:
   (a) Qualify the absolute safety statement at line 7: the diff and local logs show no prohibited external action, but they are NOT a complete execution audit proving universal absence.
   (b) Disclose the four policy-log denials: three merge-guard denials on compound read commands and one denial on an expanded policy-tool command. No evidence of a bypass; the displayed command text showed no push/merge attempt. The receipt must disclose them.
   (c) Correct the D73 line: PR #357 REMOVES/retires the obsolete parked-invites row (supported by #329's merge) — it does not "close" it as done.
   (d) Complete the leftover-state inventory: include the pre-existing modified .harness/metrics.jsonl and the untracked agents/cache runtime artifacts.

3. DO NOT close any other items. The 19 already-shipped items stay deferred to PR #357 bookkeeping (accepted judgment call). S2–S17, H3–H6, Y4, Section 46, and the route access-boundary acceptance stay parked — those genuinely require Jeremy / production evidence.

4. PRESERVE as BLOCKED-NEEDS-JEREMY in the receipt/handoff:
   (1) Hosted Auth configuration evidence contradiction — CLAUDE.md and SECURITY.md still name hosted Confirm email / secure email change as a production precondition, while #357 marks the corresponding restored row done. Only Jeremy can supply confirmation or resolve that documentation/evidence contradiction. This does NOT establish the live settings are off.
   (2) Builder launch remains unproven — the Nov 12 handoff records preflight exit 143. After the owner's dependency merges, a successful authorized preflight and a fresh lease are still required. D63's passing regression tests do not prove an end-to-end son launch.

HARD LIMITS: local edits + commits on chore/dt-fullauto-run ONLY. NO push, NO PR, NO merge, NO deploy, NO spend, NO secret/.env reads. Billing: subscription first; report which route carried any model work.

RECEIPT back to Chester only: what changed per file, the new HEAD, and confirmation that nothing outside this branch was touched.
